Create and save job step table

Source: R/tables.R
create.job_step.table.Rd

Filters a scores data frame to a specific job step, formats it with theme.job_step(), and saves as PNG.

Usage

create.job_step.table(df, job.string, job_step.string, path.table = tempdir())

Arguments

df

A data frame from get_jtbd_scores()

job.string

Job name for the filename

job_step.string

Job step to filter to

path.table

Directory to save the PNG (default: tempdir())

Value

The gt table object (also saved as PNG)

See also

Other tables: create.pct.table(), gt_theme_jtbd(), theme.job_step()
